import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify strong candidates based on t-statistics and effect sizes
    strong_candidates = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if feats.types[i] != 'derived':
            t_stat = abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, i], feats.x[feats.y==0, i]).statistic)
            effect_size = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, i]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, i])
            strong_candidates.append((fid, abs(effect_size), t_stat))
    
    # Sort by effect size and t-statistic
    strong_candidates.sort(key=lambda x: (x[1], x[2]), reverse=True)
    
    # Remove near-duplicates (correlated features)
    filtered_candidates = []
    used_fids = set()
    
    for fid, effect_size, t_stat in strong_candidates:
        if fid in used_fids:
            continue
            
        # Check correlations with already selected features
        is_duplicate = False
        for selected_fid in filtered_candidates:
            col_a = feats.column(selected_fid)
            col_b = feats.column(fid)
            if abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col_a], feats.x[:, col_b])[0,1]) > 0.6:
                is_duplicate = True
                break
        
        if not is_duplicate:
            filtered_candidates.append(fid)
            used_fids.add(fid)
            
        if len(filtered_candidates) >= MAX_DRIVERS:
            break
    
    # Select top drivers (at most 4 as per checker report)
    drivers = tuple(filtered_candidates[:4])
    
    # Use all features with high mutual information
    mi_scores = mutual_info_classif(feats.x, feats.y)
    columns = tuple([feats.ids[i] for i in range(len(feats.ids)) if mi_scores[i] > 0.1])
    
    # Add interaction terms for top features
    products = []
    top_features = list(columns[:10])  # Limit to top 10 features for interactions
    
    for i in range(len(top_features)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(top_features)):
            if top_features[i] in drivers and top_features[j] in drivers:
                products.append((top_features[i], top_features[j]))
    
    # Create loadings for weighted score
    loadings = {}
    for fid in columns:
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        # Weight by standardized coefficient from univariate analysis
        t_stat = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx], feats.x[feats.y==0, idx]).statistic
        loadings[fid] = abs(t_stat)
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=tuple(products), loadings=loadings)
